name: "Advanced Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme
benefit: - **Course Fee:** as Prescribed by the Training Institution.- **Stipend:** ₹2,500/- Per Month Per Trainee.- **Accommodation Charges:** ₹500/- Per Month Per Trainee.- **Travelling Allowance:** Restricted to to-and-fro 2nd Class (Berth) Train Fare.- **Period of Training:** As Prescribed by the Training Unit/institution.
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry or a continuous resident for the past three years.
- The applicant should possess the education qualification as required by the Training Unit/Institution.
